title: node_name empty fallback in client_node untested
description: If caller.identity.node_name is empty (Headscale without MagicDNS), events_handler falls back to caller.identity.display(). This path is never exercised — make_whois_resp always supplies 'test-node'. A future refactor of the fallback logic could silently regress to logging an empty string or user_id where node_name was expected, with no test catching it. Add a test that connects with a WhoIsResponse whose node.name is empty and asserts the warn log (or at least that the connection is not rejected).
